newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ALCO FIRM GOES PUBLIC JANUARY 15-17.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ALCO FIRM GOES PUBLIC JANUARY 15-17.

text.p: Public subscriptions to the IPO of Alco Hellas SA, an aluminium extrusion manufacturer, started today and will go on through January 17.

Alco will be listed on the bourse's parallel market and is issuing 411,610 new common bearer shares at 1,250 drachmas a share to raise a total of 514 million drachmas, said Yannis Apostolakos, head of corporate finance at co-underwriter Omega Securities.
The IPO proceeeds will go towards financing the firm's 2.5 billion investment programme under its three-year business plan, said Apostolakos.
Alco posted pretax earnings of 300 million drachmas in 1995 on turnover of 3.1 billion drachmas, he said.
1996 pretax profits are estimated at 441 million drachmas or a 7.4 price-earnings ratio and turnover at 3.7 billion drachmas, said Apostolakos.

"1997 turnover is projected at 4.4 billion drachmas and pretax earnings at 480 million drachmas. These are very conservative estimates," said Apostolakos who pointed out that Alco gained market share in 1996 which was a bad year for its sector.
Private Ergo Bank is the lead underwriter for the issue. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
